module


public import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Cast.Order.Ring
public import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Set.Defs
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Pointwise.Interval
import Mathlib.Tactic

@[expose] public section

theorem Nat.image_mul_two_Iio_even {n : ℕ} (h : Even n) :
    (2 * ·) '' Set.Iio (n / 2) = { n | Even n } ∩ Set.Iio n := by
  aesop (add simp [even_iff_two_dvd, dvd_iff_exists_eq_mul_right])

theorem Nat.image_mul_two_Iio (n : ℕ) :
    (2 * ·) '' Set.Iio ((n + 1) / 2) = { n | Even n } ∩ Set.Iio n := by
  aesop (add simp [even_iff_two_dvd, dvd_iff_exists_eq_mul_right, mul_comm, lt_div_iff_mul_lt])

review.notes: Both declarations are faithful elementary interval identities. The file introduces no definitions or generated twins and cites no external source. Natural-number division is intentional: k < (n + 1) / 2 iff 2*k < n; under Even n, k < n / 2 has the same meaning. Thus the images are exactly the even naturals strictly below n, including zero when n > 0 and giving the empty set when n = 0. No duplicate Mathlib declaration was found. The only explicit uses are in Nat.hasDensity_even, where the interval bounds and subsequent cardinality calculations are consistent; no problem file directly uses either lemma.
